name: scan

test_list.description: Two scans of the same tree give identical manifests (sorted, byte-exact hashes).
With the previous ScanCache, unchanged files (same size+mtime) are reused, not rehashed.
Same-size edit with a restored mtime is missed by Fast mode and caught by Paranoid mode.
Denied files never enter the manifest and are listed in the outcome's denied set.
Entry hashes equal blake3 of the raw bytes (no EOL translation).
A file starting with '#!' is marked executable; others are not.
A junction pointing outside the workspace is recorded as a link and never followed.
Explicit limits reject excessive walk entries, manifest entries, path bytes, file bytes, and aggregate bytes.
The canonical manifest digest changes when any entry identity or metadata changes.
A generated 10k-file tree completes cold scan, cache reuse, and a no-op plan with measured durations.

output_description: Manifest, new cache, denied paths and hashing statistics.
